note: Leads are preserved opportunities, alternatives, defects-to-watch, and open verification items. None is a v1 minimum requirement; each names the condition under which it becomes worth pursuing.

leads.title: Region map-pack exchange as a feature
leads.description: Survey teams exchange bounded GeoPackage tile/feature packs per region; FieldLedger imports the file, records its license and attribution into the project, and surfaces obligations in exports.
leads.basis: GeoPackage as portable SQLite container (S4); ODbL attribution/share-alike obligations (S8); Natural Earth public-domain base (S10).
leads.condition: Useful as soon as a second survey region or team appears.

leads.title: CRDT-based real-time synchronization
leads.description: An Automerge-family CRDT could subsume parts of the explicit merge design for near-real-time collaboration between machines.
leads.basis: Deferred mechanism family (V14 breadth lane); not investigated to source depth this stage.
leads.condition: Only if teams adopt shared network storage; explicit-conflict merge remains the offline-exchange contract regardless.
leads.status: deferred; no automatic-perfect-merge promise exists in this proposal

leads.title: Vector tiles via PMTiles/MapLibre for basemap quality
leads.description: Replace raster XYZ mappack with a single-file vector tile archive and a vector renderer when basemap detail or size becomes limiting.
leads.basis: Deferred rendering family; Leaflet raster path pinned for v1 (S15).
leads.condition: If mappack size or visual quality blocks field use.

leads.title: EXIF/GNSS provenance extraction from photographs
leads.description: Read capture timestamp/GPS from photo EXIF to pre-fill observation time provenance and offer geometry suggestion (never silent adoption).
leads.basis: Time-provenance field design in proposal 6.3; EXIF primary spec not yet pinned.
leads.condition: After v1 photo attachment flow stabilizes; requires pinning the EXIF specification as a new source.
leads.status: deferred; source pin required before design commitment

leads.title: Polygon digitizing and Multi* geometry support
leads.description: Extend geometry support beyond Point/LineString; brings winding normalization and RFC 7946 3.1.6/3.1.9 semantics fully into scope.
leads.basis: RFC 7946 sections pinned (S1); winding failure precedent investigated via turf chain (S12/S13).
leads.condition: When survey protocols require area observations.
leads.status: deferred; boundary behavior already designed, needs fixtures

leads.title: PROJ resource-file bundling budget
leads.description: Measure on-disk size and cold-start cost of bundling PROJ resource files (proj.db et al.) locally under PROJ_DATA.
leads.status: open; UNCERTAIN flagged in proposal section 14

leads.title: Re-verify current-state @turf/rewind (post-2017)
leads.description: Confirm the winding fix remains in current turf releases and whether further winding-related fixes landed; the investigated chain is pinned to 2017 milestone 4.3.0.
leads.basis: S12/S13 pins; current-tree re-verification not performed this stage.
leads.condition: Before adopting any turf module for geometry predicates.

leads.title: Fuzzy spatial/temporal duplicate finder
leads.description: Flag (never auto-merge) observations within X meters and Y seconds of each other across batches, with review UI.
leads.basis: Duplicate-handling design in proposal 7.3; thresholds need ecological input.
leads.condition: After merge workflow stabilizes; requires user-configurable thresholds.

leads.title: Accessibility conformance pass
leads.description: Contrast, focus order, screen-reader labels for table/map/conflict screens; keyboard-only completion of the full session script.
leads.basis: Leaflet advertises keyboard navigation (S15); the rest is FieldLedger UI under design.

leads.title: Watch: Leaflet antimeridian issues (#9878 open)
leads.description: Leaflet #9878 (map flashes white near antimeridian, open as of 2025) and the unmerged #5164 lineage show dateline handling in the renderer is incomplete; FieldLedger splits tracks itself, but tracker should watch upstream for regressions affecting the raster path.
leads.condition: Continuous while Leaflet 1.9.x is pinned; revisit at any 2.0 upgrade (2.0.0-alpha.1 announced 2025, S15).

leads.title: Capture OSMF Tile Usage Policy when reachable
leads.description: The tile policy page could not be fetched from this environment (S9 failure recorded); numeric limits for any OSM-derived pack production remain unpinned.
leads.basis: S8 pins the no-free-tiles statement and policy links; S9 records the fetch failure.
leads.condition: Only if the optional OSM-derived mappack route is exercised.
leads.status: open; UNCERTAIN flagged in proposal section 14

leads.title: FTS5 full-text search over notes
leads.description: SQLite FTS5 index over observation notes for fast offline search; must be kept in transactional scope with the revision log.
leads.basis: SQLite platform capability; FTS docs not pinned this stage.
leads.condition: If attribute search proves insufficient at 250k rows.
